_options._note: NAME IS GENERIC ON PURPOSE: straddle (offsets 0/0), strangle (default +150/-150) or fly (wing_points > 0) are the same strategy with different config. options_intraday_short_premium (docs/hypotheses/I_options_intraday_short_premium.md). Registry shim ONLY -- the real logic is src/options/short_premium.py (entry, per-leg SL, time exit), driven by orchestrator._options_intraday_short_premium_loop every poll_seconds, rules in config/options_settings.json options_trading.options_intraday_short_premium (every parameter editable there, applied on the next tick). entry_conditions are deliberately impossible (RSI > 1000) so this spec never fires through the per-bar USS scan (same shim as options_expiry_day.json); direction MUST stay LONG. 'enabled' in the registry IS a live switch, and this name is what CRM G9 llm_gate_required, execution_mode and the G7 uncapped exemption key on.
